add.title: Marvel Zombies
add.text: Years later, Okoye is a zombie herself but keeps her mind, and she leads a horde that includes the zombie Captain America and Hawkeye against the North Institute for Wanda.
add.whoA: Fallen heroes Okoye later leads in Wanda's horde.
add.whoB: Turned herself, she later leads them for Wanda.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: Hunting Apocalypse, Cable ambushes Warren and learns that Dr. Adler, whose cure Warren backs, has moved to Muir Island.
add.whoA: Ambushes Warren to find Dr. Adler.
add.whoB: The backer of Dr. Adler's cure, whom Cable ambushes.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: Sean is Moira's fiance and helps her run her mutant research center on Muir Island, where Xavier comes to rest.
add.whoA: Sean's fiancee.
add.whoB: Moira's fiance.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: Beast makes a vaccine from Wolverine's blood that stops the plague Apocalypse unleashes, and Apocalypse slips away.
add.whoA: His plague is stopped by Beast's vaccine.
add.whoB: Makes the vaccine against Apocalypse's plague.

add.title: X-Men '97
add.text: Xavier's will makes Magneto the leader of the X-Men, and Beast serves on the team under him.
add.whoA: Leads Beast's team under Xavier's will.
add.whoB: One of the X-Men Magneto leads.

add.title: X-Men '97
add.text: Stranded in ancient Egypt, Beast builds a time device from Apocalypse's Ship, and Magneto uses it to send him and the others home before Apocalypse kills Magneto.
add.whoA: Sends Beast home from ancient Egypt, then dies at Apocalypse's hands.
add.whoB: Builds the time device Magneto uses to send him home.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: Sinister has the brainwashed Morph sabotage the Danger Room, and Beast is nearly killed.
add.whoA: Nearly kills Beast with a Danger Room trap.
add.whoB: Nearly killed by Sinister's Danger Room trap.

add.title: X-Men '97
add.text: Hiding in a Sahara junkyard, Trask has Sentinels and a Master Mold again, and they fight the X-Men until he is captured.
add.whoA: Trask's creations, which he sets against the X-Men again.
add.whoB: Their maker, hiding with them in the Sahara.

add.title: X-Men '97
add.text: Terrified after the massacre on Genosha, Trask falls to his death, and hidden programming turns him into a human-Sentinel hybrid until Cable stops him with an EMP.
add.whoA: Trask's creations, which in the end make him one of them.
add.whoB: Their maker, turned into a human-Sentinel hybrid.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: At a missile base, Magneto easily beats Scott, Storm and Wolverine, and he declares the X-Men his enemies.
add.whoA: Xavier's old friend, who easily beats Scott at a missile base.
add.whoB: An X-Man Magneto easily beats at a missile base.

add.title: X-Men '97
add.text: Mojo pulls Jubilee and Roberto into a video game built from her old adventures. With help from a digital copy of herself, she beats him and gets them both home.
add.whoA: Traps Jubilee in a video game of her own adventures.
add.whoB: Escapes Mojo's video game and beats him.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: Grieving the loss of Jean, Scott lashes out at Xavier and quits the X-Men. He comes back with his faith in Xavier's ideals renewed.
add.whoA: Xavier's field leader. Quits in grief over Jean, then returns.
add.whoB: Scott's mentor. Scott walks out on him, then comes back.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: Bishop crashes into Xavier's mansion to stop the X-Men. Xavier keeps Wolverine from killing him and reads his memories of the future.
add.whoA: A time traveler whose memories Xavier reads after he attacks the mansion.
add.whoB: Reads Bishop's memories of the future and spares him.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: At a missile base, Magneto easily beats Storm, Cyclops and Wolverine, but Storm stops the missiles he launches.
add.whoA: Xavier's old friend, whose missiles Storm stops.
add.whoB: The X-Man who stops his missiles.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
add.text: At a missile base, Magneto easily beats Wolverine, Cyclops and Storm and sends them back to Xavier with a message.
add.whoA: Xavier's old friend, who easily beats Logan at a missile base.
add.whoB: An X-Man Magneto easily beats at a missile base.

add.title: X2
add.text: After Jean dies at Alkali Lake, Scott breaks down on Logan's shoulder. Back at the school, Logan tells him that Jean made her choice, and it was Scott.
add.whoA: The man Jean chose. Logan tells him so after she dies.
add.whoB: Tells Scott that Jean chose him.

add.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
add.text: Logan covers for the grieving Scott and urges him to move on from Jean. When Scott rides to Alkali Lake and is killed, Logan finds only his glasses.
add.whoA: A grieving teammate. Killed at Alkali Lake.
add.whoB: Urges Scott to move on, then finds only his glasses.

add.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
add.text: Storm and Logan find Jean alive at Alkali Lake and bring her home, but as the Phoenix she turns on the X-Men and leaves with Magneto.
add.whoA: Brings Jean home from Alkali Lake.
add.whoB: Returns as the Phoenix and turns on the X-Men.

add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
add.text: In Paris, Hank helps stop Raven from killing Trask. When Erik tries to kill her, Hank fights him off so she can escape.
add.whoA: Fights off Erik to save Raven in Paris.
add.whoB: The woman Hank saves from Erik in Paris.

edit.text: Victor is Logan's older half-brother, and they fight side by side through a century of wars. Victor's cruelty drives them apart, and Logan hunts him for revenge before they team up against Weapon XI.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: In the Void, Sabretooth recognizes Logan and challenges him to a fight, and Logan cuts off his head.
add.whoA: His half-brother, whom Logan beheads in the Void.
add.whoB: The half-brother who beheads Sabretooth in the Void.

add.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
add.text: In the Void, John has Toad knock Logan out and brings him to Cassandra. When John later guns her down for Paradox, Logan knocks him out with a punch.
add.whoA: A former student who captures Logan for Cassandra, and whom Logan punches out.
add.whoB: Captured by John in the Void, then knocks him out.

add.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
add.text: Stryker keeps Logan caged at Alkali Lake as his Weapon X experiment, until Jean frees him and he tears through Stryker's soldiers.
add.whoA: Keeps Logan caged at Alkali Lake as Weapon X.
add.whoB: The caged Weapon X who breaks loose at Alkali Lake.

edit.text: Alex and Chase are old friends who reunite to uncover PRIDE.
edit.whoA: Alex's old friend.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2
add.text: Alex and Chase run away together as the Runaways.
add.whoA: Alex's friend and fellow runaway.
add.whoB: Chase's friend and fellow runaway.

edit.text: Jonah, wearing Victor's body, overpowers Chase and traps him with Karolina and Janet in his healing algorithm.

add.title: Runaways S3
add.text: Chase pins Jonah down to kill him, but Jonah taunts him about watching the light leave his father's eyes, and Chase falters long enough for Jonah to throw him off.
add.whoA: The alien wearing Victor's body, whom Chase cannot bring himself to kill.
add.whoB: Victor's son, who pins Jonah but cannot strike.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2
add.text: Jonah buys Geoffrey's land and takes him on as a partner, and Geoffrey goes on to kill for Jonah in PRIDE's sacrifices.
add.whoA: The man who makes Geoffrey his partner, and whom PRIDE kills for.
add.whoB: A PRIDE leader who kills for Jonah.

add.title: Runaways S3
add.text: When Nico banishes Jonah and his family, Jonah is driven out of Victor's body.
add.whoA: Heals Victor, then wears his body until Nico drives him out.
add.whoB: The PRIDE member whose body Jonah takes, then loses.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2
add.text: After learning Victor is dying, Janet ends her affair with Robert to stand by her husband.
add.whoA: Janet's former lover. She ends the affair to stand by Victor.
add.whoB: Robert's former lover, who ends the affair.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger
add.text: Evita marries Baron Samedi to bring Tyrone back from the Dark Dimension, giving up her chance at love. Afterward she keeps her distance from him.
add.whoA: Marries Baron Samedi to bring Tyrone back, then keeps her distance.
add.whoB: The young man Evita gives up love to save.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger
add.text: Tyrone finds Chantelle dead in her shop, killed by Andre.
add.whoA: The voodoo priestess who guides Tyrone, until Andre kills her.
add.whoB: The young man Chantelle guides, who finds her dead.

edit.text: Gideon Malick, a fellow HYDRA leader, once hoped Alexander Pierce would share his faith in Hive, but found him too bloodthirsty.
edit.whoA: A fellow HYDRA leader, who finds Pierce too bloodthirsty.

add.title: Captain America: Brave New World
add.text: Thaddeus Ross keeps trying to reach his estranged daughter. After he is locked in the Raft, Betty visits him and they begin to make peace.
add.whoA: Betty's father, who reaches out to her. She visits him in the Raft.
add.whoB: Ross's daughter, who visits him in the Raft to make peace.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: As Crossbones, Rumlow fights Natasha in Lagos and tries to kill her by dropping a grenade into the armored truck she is trapped in.
add.whoA: An old foe Rumlow fights in Lagos and tries to kill with a grenade.
add.whoB: As Crossbones, fights Natasha in Lagos and tries to kill her with a grenade.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: On the Time Heist, Steve steps into an elevator with the Rumlow of 2012 and fools him and Sitwell into handing over Loki's scepter with a whispered "Hail Hydra."
add.whoA: Fools a past Rumlow into handing over the scepter with a "Hail Hydra."
add.whoB: A HYDRA agent of 2012, fooled into handing Steve the scepter.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Bruce and Natasha work together on the Time Heist. When she gives her life on Vormir, Bruce mourns her and tries to bring her back with the Stones, but cannot.
add.whoA: A teammate lost on Vormir, whom Bruce tries and fails to bring back.
add.whoB: An old flame, who tries and fails to bring Natasha back with the Stones.

add.title: Ms. Marvel
add.text: Sadie Deever ignores Cleary's order to stand down and storms Coles Academic High School after Kamran and Ms. Marvel. Cleary relieves her of duty.
add.whoA: A Damage Control agent who defies Cleary's orders, until he relieves her of duty.
add.whoB: Sadie's superior, who relieves her of duty for defying him.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Before Steve Rogers takes the Infinity Stones back to their own times, Bucky Barnes says goodbye to him, knowing his best friend will not come back. Steve stays in the past to live out his life.
add.whoA: Bucky's best friend since Brooklyn. Says goodbye before staying in the past.
add.whoB: Steve's best friend, who sees him off before he stays in the past.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Clint loses Laura to the Snap on the family farm and is reunited with her five years later, when she calls him after the Blip.
add.whoA: Clint's wife, lost to the Snap and found again five years later.
add.whoB: Laura's husband, who loses her to the Snap and gets her back five years later.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Clint loses Nathaniel to the Snap and is reunited with him five years later.
add.whoA: Clint's youngest son, lost to the Snap and found again five years later.
add.whoB: Nathaniel's dad, who loses him to the Snap and gets him back five years later.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: In the Battle of Earth, Okoye kills Corvus Glaive, and Proxima Midnight cradles his body as Tony Stark's snap turns them both to dust.
add.whoA: Fellow child of Thanos who holds Corvus's body as they turn to dust.
add.whoB: Fellow child of Thanos, killed in the Battle of Earth. Proxima holds him as they turn to dust.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: In the Battle of Earth, Cull Obsidian tries to stab Tony Stark, but Peter webs him off his feet and Scott Lang crushes him underfoot.
add.whoA: Webs Cull off his feet in the Battle of Earth, leaving him to be crushed.
add.whoB: A Black Order brute Peter webs off his feet before Scott crushes him.

edit.text: Quill leaves Cosmo and Kraglin to guard Knowhere while the Guardians go to save Rocket. She later links the two ships so Quill can bring the rescued children home.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Darren Cross, now M.O.D.O.K. and working for Kang, shows himself to Hank, wrecks his ship and leaves him to die. He later turns on Kang and dies with Hank and his family around him.
add.whoA: Cross's old mentor, whose ship he wrecks before turning on Kang and dying.
add.whoB: Hank's old protege, back as M.O.D.O.K. Wrecks his ship, then dies turning on Kang.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
add.text: Darren Cross returns as M.O.D.O.K., Kang's enforcer in the Quantum Realm. He later turns on Kang and, dying with Hope beside him, remarks on her new hair.
add.whoA: Cross's old colleague, beside him when he dies turning on Kang.
add.whoB: Hope's old boss, back as M.O.D.O.K. Dies beside her after turning on Kang.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: Darcy stands by Jane through her stage four cancer, going with her to chemotherapy and urging her not to face it alone.
add.whoA: Close friend Darcy stands by through stage four cancer.
add.whoB: A close friend who goes with Jane to chemotherapy and urges her not to face cancer alone.

add.title: Thor
add.text: Nick Fury brings Erik Selvig to a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility and asks him to study the Tesseract.
add.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D. director who brings Selvig in to study the Tesseract.
add.whoB: Scientist Fury brings in to study the Tesseract.

add.title: Thor
add.text: Unseen, Loki secretly works on Erik Selvig's mind and prompts him to agree to study the Tesseract for Nick Fury.
add.whoA: God who secretly prompts Selvig to study the Tesseract.
add.whoB: Scientist Loki secretly prompts to study the Tesseract for S.H.I.E.L.D.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Drax, joins him and the Guardians to break into the Orgoscope for Rocket's code, and she helps him walk back to the ship after the fight.
add.whoA: A Gamora from 2014 who never knew Drax. Helps him on the mission to save Rocket.
add.whoB: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, whom she helps on the mission to save Rocket.

add.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
add.text: Ross secretly passes Ramonda word of the United States' plans against Wakanda. After she dies in Namor's attack, Valentina arrests him for his contact with her.
add.whoA: Wakanda's queen, whom Ross secretly feeds U.S. intelligence until her death.
add.whoB: CIA agent who secretly warns Ramonda of U.S. plans against Wakanda.

add.title: Thor: The Dark World
add.text: Kurse kills Frigga when Malekith attacks the palace. Odin holds his wife's body and mourns her at her funeral.
add.whoA: Frigga's husband, who holds her body after Malekith's attack.
add.whoB: Odin's wife and queen, killed in Malekith's attack on the palace.

edit.text: Gamora looks out for the young Groot in battle, warning him out of harm's way during the fight with the Abilisk.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
add.text: Gamora and Groot first meet brawling over the Orb on Xandar, escape the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. Groot gives his life to shield the team when the Dark Aster crashes.
add.whoA: Fellow founding Guardian, who gives his life to shield the team.
add.whoB: Fellow founding Guardian, first met brawling over the Orb on Xandar.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Thanos tortures the captive Nebula, and Gamora gives up the Soul Stone's location to save her sister. Thanos then sacrifices Gamora on Vormir.
add.whoA: Sister whose torture makes Gamora give up the Soul Stone.
add.whoB: Sister who gives up the Soul Stone to save Nebula from torture.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: The future Nebula tells a Gamora from 2014 that they become sisters, and Gamora frees her to stop Thanos. When the 2014 Nebula refuses to change sides and aims at Gamora, the future Nebula kills her younger self.
add.whoA: Sister from the future, who wins this younger Gamora to her side.
add.whoB: A Gamora from 2014, who frees Nebula after learning they become sisters.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: Quill keeps trying to win back the Gamora from 2014, who rejects him and lashes out when he compares her to his Gamora. At the end he accepts who she is, and they part warmly when she leaves with the Ravagers.
add.whoA: A former teammate who finally accepts she isn't his Gamora. They part warmly.
add.whoB: A Gamora from 2014 who rejects Quill, then parts from him warmly.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Thanos from 2014 learns of his future and brings a younger Gamora with him to 2023. Unsettled by what she learns, she frees the captive Nebula and turns against him.
add.whoA: Adoptive father, whose 2014 self this younger Gamora defects from.
add.whoB: Adopted daughter. A Gamora from 2014 turns against him in 2023.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Rocket, helps the Guardians hunt for the code to save his life, and on Counter-Earth she shields the dying Rocket from Adam Warlock and War Pig.
add.whoA: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, whom she shields while he lies dying.
add.whoB: A Gamora from 2014, a stranger who shields Rocket while he lies dying.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Groot goes with Rocket and Thor to Nidavellir and fights beside them in Wakanda. In the Snap he turns to dust in front of Rocket, calling out to him as he fades.
add.whoA: Groot's surrogate father, who watches him fade in the Snap.
add.whoB: The young Groot Rocket raises, who fades to dust in front of him.

add.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
add.text: Hank has cut Scott off for two years, angry that taking the suit to Germany forced him and Hope into hiding. When Scott gets a message from Janet, Hank brings him back in, and they work together to rescue her from the Quantum Realm.
add.whoA: Hank's pupil, cut off over Germany, then brought back to help rescue Janet.
add.whoB: Scott's mentor, angry with him over Germany, who brings him back to rescue Janet.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs the simulation that cracks time travel for Tony. After he uses the Stones to beat Thanos, she reports to Pepper that his life functions are critical as he dies.
add.whoA: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, whose dying moments she reports after the Battle of Earth.
add.whoB: Tony's A.I., who helps him crack time travel and reports him dying.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: Tony dies after using the Stones to beat Thanos. Happy mourns him at the funeral and promises his daughter Morgan all the cheeseburgers she wants, as her father liked.
add.whoA: Happy's boss and old friend, who dies after the Battle of Earth.
add.whoB: Tony's old friend, who mourns him and looks after his daughter.

add.title: Secret Invasion
add.text: Talos tells G'iah that her mother was killed by Gravik, the rebel leader G'iah has been working for.
add.whoA: G'iah's mother, killed by Gravik while G'iah works for him.
add.whoB: Soren's daughter, who learns from Talos that Gravik killed her.

add.title: Loki S2
add.text: Miss Minutes shows Renslayer a memory of her building the TVA beside He Who Remains, who then had her memories of their partnership erased. Angered, Renslayer decides to run the TVA without him.
add.whoA: TVA judge who built it beside him, then learns he erased her memories.
add.whoB: The TVA's founder, who built it with Renslayer, then erased her memories.

add.title: Loki S2
add.text: Miss Minutes, who loved her creator but resents that he kept her as his assistant, shows Renslayer the past he erased. The two decide to run the TVA without any version of him.
add.whoA: His A.I., who loved him, then sets out to run the TVA without him.
add.whoB: Miss Minutes' creator, whom she loved, but who kept her as his assistant.

add.title: Thor: The Dark World
add.text: To help Thor smuggle Jane out of Asgard against Odin's orders, Heimdall summons Odin to the Bifrost and confesses to treason to keep him distracted.
add.whoA: Heimdall's king, to whom he confesses treason to cover Thor's escape.
add.whoB: Guardian of the Bifrost, who confesses treason to Odin to cover Thor's escape.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: After Jane dies, Heimdall welcomes her to Valhalla and thanks her for helping save his son.
add.whoA: Asgard's watchman, who welcomes Jane to Valhalla after she dies.
add.whoB: Thor's love, whom Heimdall welcomes to Valhalla.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: When Tony dies after using the Stones to destroy Thanos and his army, Rhodey is at his side, and he later mourns him at the funeral.
add.whoA: Rhodes's best friend, at whose side he kneels as he dies.
add.whoB: Tony's best friend, at his side as he dies.

add.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
add.text: Ultron attacks J.A.R.V.I.S., who survives by hiding inside the internet. Tony and Bruce then upload him into the synthetic body that becomes Vision.
add.whoA: Uploads what is left of J.A.R.V.I.S. into the body that becomes Vision.
add.whoB: The AI Tony creates, uploaded into Vision's body after Ultron's attack.

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Years later J.A.R.V.I.S. lives inside the White Vision's Mindspace, where he looks after the household and helps Vision learn to fit in among people.
add.whoA: The synthezoid whose Mindspace J.A.R.V.I.S. looks after.
add.whoB: An AI in Vision's Mindspace, who looks out for him like an older brother.

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: When Paladin's adamantium rounds leave Vision dying, J.A.R.V.I.S. deletes his own program to reroute power and save him.
add.whoA: The synthezoid J.A.R.V.I.S. gives his life to save.
add.whoB: An AI in Vision's Mindspace, who deletes himself to save him.

add.title: Iron Man 2
add.text: When Vanko takes over Rhodes's War Machine armor at the Stark Expo, Natasha, undercover at Stark Industries, breaks into Hammer's system and gives him back control.
add.whoA: Undercover S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who gives Rhodes back control of his armor.
add.whoB: War Machine, whose armor Natasha frees from Vanko's control.

add.title: Thor
add.text: Jasper Sitwell serves under Phil Coulson at the S.H.I.E.L.D. site around Mjolnir in New Mexico, and warns him when Thor breaks in.
add.whoA: Sitwell's commander at the Mjolnir site in New Mexico.
add.whoB: An agent under Coulson at the Mjolnir site, who warns him of Thor's break-in.

edit.text: Nebula and Mantis meet on Ego's planet, where Mantis tells her and Gamora about Ego's dead children. They then fight on the same side against Ego.

add.title: Captain America: Civil War
add.text: When the Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, Natasha sides with Tony and Wanda with Steve. At the airport battle, Wanda pins Natasha with her powers and throws her away from Clint.
add.whoA: Natasha's trainee, who sides with Steve and throws her aside at the airport.
add.whoB: Wanda's trainer, who sides with Tony over the Accords.

add.title: Avengers: Infinity War
add.text: Natasha, Steve and Sam rescue Wanda and Vision from Proxima Midnight and Corvus Glaive in Edinburgh. In Wakanda, Wanda saves Natasha and Okoye from the Threshers, and they step in when Proxima moves to kill her.
add.whoA: A fellow fugitive Natasha rescues in Edinburgh, who saves her in Wakanda.
add.whoB: A fellow fugitive who rescues Wanda in Edinburgh, then fights beside her in Wakanda.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
add.text: Rocket is left on Berhert to guard Nebula, the Guardians' prisoner, but she gets free and joins the Ravager mutiny that locks him up. Later she fights beside him and the Guardians to save Quill from Ego.
add.whoA: A Guardian who guards Nebula on Berhert, then fights beside her against Ego.
add.whoB: The Guardians' prisoner, who joins the mutiny that locks Rocket up, then fights beside him.

add.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
add.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and Okoye weeps as she helps carry his casket at his funeral.
add.whoA: Okoye's king, whose casket she helps carry when he dies of an illness.
add.whoB: T'Challa's closest protector, who helps carry his casket at his funeral.

add.title: Loki S2
add.text: Sylvie enchants Hunter X-05, who works for Renslayer, and through him prunes Renslayer.
add.whoA: A variant Renslayer arrested as a child, who later prunes her.
add.whoB: The judge who arrested Sylvie as a child, whom Sylvie prunes.

add.title: Jessica Jones S1
add.text: Alisa Jones is Jessica's mother. She is in the car with the family when it crashes on a road trip, leaving Jessica without her family.
add.whoA: Alisa's daughter, in the car when the family crashes.
add.whoB: Jessica's mother, lost in the family's car crash.

add.title: Jessica Jones S2
add.text: After Alisa escapes prison, Jessica goes on the run with her mother. At Playland, Trish shoots Alisa dead in front of Jessica.
add.whoA: Alisa's daughter, who goes on the run with her and sees her shot dead.
add.whoB: Jessica's mother, who goes on the run with her until Trish shoots her dead.

add.title: Jessica Jones S2
add.text: Trish visits Alisa in prison. Alisa blames Trish's IGH investigation for every killing she has done and says she should have killed her when she had the chance.
add.whoA: Jessica's sister, whose IGH investigation Alisa blames for her killings.
add.whoB: Jessica's mother, a killer who blames Trish for her crimes.

add.title: Jessica Jones S2
add.text: Will Simpson learns that the IGH killer may go after Trish Walker and tries to protect her. The killer tracks him down at the Greenpoint Stages and kills him.
add.whoA: A man trying to protect Trish from her. She kills him.
add.whoB: The killer Simpson tries to warn Trish about, who kills him.

add.title: The Punisher S2
add.text: Curtis Hoyle stands up for Amy when Frank nearly shoots her in the campervan Curtis lent them, then stays with her and tells her Frank cares about her.
add.whoA: Frank's friend, who gives Amy and Frank a campervan to hide in.
add.whoB: A girl Curtis hides in a campervan.

add.title: The Punisher S2
add.text: Curtis looks after Amy in the campervan while Frank hunts Billy Russo, and they talk about her dream of marine salvage.
add.whoA: Frank's friend, who looks after Amy for Frank.
add.whoB: A girl Curtis hides in a campervan, and looks after for Frank.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
add.text: May joins Anne Weaver on Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. council. Weaver presses her for answers about Coulson's secret Theta Protocol, but May gives away very little.
add.whoA: A fellow council member who gives away very little.
add.whoB: A fellow council member who presses May about Theta.

edit.whoA: A teammate Trip fights beside on mission after mission.

add.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
add.text: After Matt reveals in court that he is Daredevil, Powell signals a sniper to shoot him in the courthouse lobby, but the real Bullseye fires at Fisk instead. Both end up in prison at Rikers.
add.whoA: Hector's lawyer, revealed as Daredevil. Powell orders him shot at the courthouse.
add.whoB: Arrests Matt's client Hector and jumps Matt. Later orders him shot at the courthouse.

edit.text: After Ridenhour is murdered, Ridley returns to lead his precinct and tells Misty about the lessons she learned from him over the years.

add.title: Daredevil S3
add.text: FBI agent Ray Nadeem meets Fisk in prison, and Fisk asks him for a deal.
add.whoA: A jailed crime boss who asks Nadeem for a deal.
add.whoB: The FBI agent Fisk asks for a deal from prison.

add.title: Daredevil S3
add.text: Hattley brands the dead Nadeem a killer, but his dying declaration names her as Winn's murderer, and once Fisk is arrested she corroborates it.
add.whoA: Nadeem's FBI boss, whom his dying declaration names as Winn's killer.
add.whoB: An agent Hattley frames for murder, whose dying declaration exposes her.

add.title: Daredevil S3
add.text: Once Fisk is arrested at his wedding and can no longer hurt her daughter, Hattley corroborates Nadeem's dying declaration against him.
add.whoA: Kills one of Tammy's children to force her obedience, until she turns on him.
add.whoB: An FBI chief Fisk forces to serve him, who then backs the evidence against him.

edit.whoA: His mistress, who calls him to duel the Iron Fist to the death.
edit.whoB: One of her champions, called to duel the Iron Fist to the death.

add.title: Luke Cage S1
add.text: After Cottonmouth's death, Shades tells Zip and his crew that they work for him now and hands them cash for new clothes.
add.whoA: One of Cottonmouth's crew, whom Shades takes on after Cottonmouth dies.
add.whoB: Takes over Zip's crew after Cottonmouth's death.

add.title: Jessica Jones S1
add.text: On Kozlov's combat pills, Simpson turns violent, and Trish sends him away, taking some of his pills.
add.whoA: Trish's ex, turned violent by combat pills.
add.whoB: Simpson's ex. Sends him away and takes his pills.

add.title: Jessica Jones S2
add.text: Simpson has been secretly following Trish to protect her from IGH. After she shoots him in the leg and ties him up, he dies holding off the killer who comes for them.
add.whoA: Trish's ex, who dies trying to protect her from IGH's killer.
add.whoB: Simpson's ex, whom he dies trying to protect.

add.title: Avengers: Endgame
add.text: In the final battle, Strange holds up a single finger to tell Tony this is the one future where they win, and Tony takes the Stones and sacrifices himself.
add.whoA: A fellow big ego. Strange signals that his sacrifice is the one way to win.
add.whoB: Signals to Tony that this is the one future where they win.

add.title: Thunderbolts*
add.text: Sent by Valentina to the same vault, Taskmaster saves Yelena from John Walker and tells her she is not there to kill her, moments before Ghost shoots Taskmaster dead.
add.whoA: A Red Room escapee Taskmaster hunts for Dreykov, then saves in Valentina's vault.
add.whoB: Dreykov's former hunter. Saves Yelena in the vault, then is shot dead by Ghost.

add.title: Daredevil S3
add.text: Sister Maggie, a nun who helped raise Matt at the orphanage, nurses him back to health after he is found near death and counsels him as he recovers.
add.whoA: The man she helped raise at the orphanage, nursed back to health in her care.
add.whoB: A nun who helped raise Matt, and nurses him back to health.

add.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
add.text: When Gorr attacks New Asgard and takes its children, Valkyrie fights beside Thor and goes with him to Omnipotence City and the Shadow Realm to get them back. She steals Zeus's thunderbolt for him, and Gorr wounds her in the Shadow Realm.
add.whoA: New Asgard's king. Joins Thor's quest to rescue the stolen children.
add.whoB: An old friend who leads the quest to rescue New Asgard's children.

edit.text: Ultron is a prisoner inside White Vision's mind. When Vision gives him control of his body to fight Jocasta, Ultron traps Vision inside his own mind and leaves with Tommy.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: In a flashback to Blade's origin, his human mother leaves him at a New Orleans orphanage after his vampire father abandons them.
add.whoA: Blade's mother, who leaves him at an orphanage.
add.whoB: Her half-vampire son, left at an orphanage.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
add.text: Mysterio joins the Sinister Six that the Master Planner re-forms at Christmas.
add.whoA: A member of Otto's new Sinister Six.
add.whoB: Mysterio's leader in the Sinister Six.

edit.text: In prison, the Vulture joins Otto's plan to break out and form the Sinister Six, and becomes his right hand.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
add.text: Toomes storms into Oscorp and berates Otto, his old colleague, for the theft of his Tech Flight design. As he is thrown out, he tells Otto he no longer blames him.
add.whoA: An old colleague who blames, then forgives, Otto.
add.whoB: The old colleague who brought Toomes's work to Oscorp.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: The Chameleon turns on the Kingpin and the Insidious Six to help Kragov free the Red Skull, who then traps the Six.
add.whoA: One of Doctor Octopus's Six, who betrays the team.
add.whoB: A teammate in the Six, whom the Chameleon betrays.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: The Lizard attacks Eddie, who then overhears that Curt Connors is the Lizard and tries to expose him, but Connors, human again, answers his door.
add.whoA: The scientist Eddie tries to expose as the Lizard.
add.whoB: A reporter who tries to expose him as the Lizard.

edit.text: Back as Venom, Eddie storms the Daily Bugle and attacks Jameson, the boss who fired him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: Felicia turns Peter down, then happily accepts when Jason asks her to dinner, and the two begin dating.
add.whoA: Felicia's new boyfriend, Jason.
add.whoB: The woman Jason starts dating.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
add.text: Pushed by Norman Osborn, a reluctant Otto runs the experiment that turns Flint Marko into the Sandman.
add.whoA: A crook Otto's experiment turns to sand.
add.whoB: The scientist whose experiment turns him to sand.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
add.text: Pushed by Hammerhead, a wary Otto bonds Alex O'Hirn to the rhino armor.
add.whoA: A thug Otto bonds to the rhino armor.
add.whoB: The scientist who bonds him to his armor.

edit.text: The Doomsday Device turns Kragov into Electro, and he injures the Kingpin, who ends up in the hospital.
edit.whoA: Traps Fisk as the Red Skull, then injures him as Electro.
edit.whoB: A crime lord he traps, then injures as Electro.

edit.text: Felicia comes back to Whistler for a weapon against Morbius, and he joins her hunt, fighting Miriam at her side.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: The Hobgoblin offers the Kingpin a partnership, and they plan a heist with the time dilation accelerator, though the Kingpin plots to double-cross him.
add.whoA: A hired killer who betrays Fisk, then partners with him on a heist.
add.whoB: The Hobgoblin's old boss, then his partner in a heist.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: In prison, Tombstone teams up with Richard Fisk, and the Kingpin frames Robbie Robertson for them and has his man break the two out.
add.whoA: Kidnaps Fisk's wife, later his son's cellmate.
add.whoB: Frames Robbie for Tombstone and breaks him out.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: The Kingpin funds the automatons Mysterio uses in his trap for Spider-Man at Wonder Studios, where Mysterio dies.
add.whoA: One of Fisk's Insidious Six. Fisk funds his last scheme.
add.whoB: Funds Mysterio's automatons.

edit.text: After her return, Mary Jane lands a role made famous by the actress Miranda Wilson, but it is a trap. Mysterio lures her in for the burned Miranda, who wants to swap bodies with her, though his machine was never built to work.
With Mary Jane lost, May moves in with her Aunt Anna to help her through the loss.
edit.whoA: May's friend Anna's niece. May grieves her loss with Anna.
edit.whoB: Peter's aunt, who moves in with Anna after Mary Jane is lost.

src: restored under the owner's implied-ties rule (4 November 2026): https://marvel.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&prop=wikitext&format=json&page=Spider-Man_(1994_animated_series)_Season_4_4

edit.text: When Mariah catches a deadly virus in Africa, Sergei saves her with the serum that once changed him, and she turns into a feral creature. A cure from Connors only partly works, and Mariah chooses to stay as she is and leaves with Kraven.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: The Chameleon poses as the husband of Dr. Groitzig's daughter to steal the evidence about Peter's parents, then leads Spider-Man into the Insidious Six's trap.
add.whoA: A spy who can wear any face.
add.whoB: Keeps catching the Chameleon.

edit.text: Peter and Mary Jane ask Connors to give her away at their wedding, but lizard creatures grown from his discarded DNA kidnap him, and he becomes the Lizard again.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: On the Beyonder's world, the Lizard attacks Spider-Man until the heroes restore Connors's mind, and Connors joins Spider-Man's team.
add.whoA: Peter's science teacher. Joins Peter's team on the Beyonder's world.
add.whoB: Connors's student. As Spider-Man, leads the team Connors joins.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
add.text: Working for the Master Planner, the Tinkerer helps Beck operate as Mysterio and builds the robot double that Spider-Man arrests in Beck's place.
add.whoA: Mysterio's partner. Builds his robot double.
add.whoB: The Tinkerer's partner, who hides behind a robot double.

edit.text: Peter and Mary Jane are finally together when the Green Goblin kidnaps her, and she vanishes into a portal during his fight with Spider-Man.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: Feeling pushed aside by Peter, Mary Jane turns to Harry and starts seeing him.
add.whoA: The woman Peter loves, who turns to Harry.
add.whoB: The man Mary Jane loves, though his secrets push her away.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: After Spider-Man saves her from the Kingpin's base, Mary Jane gives back Harry's engagement ring and tells Spider-Man that she loves someone else.
add.whoA: The woman Peter loves.
add.whoB: The man Mary Jane loves.

edit.whoA: Peter's friend, who turned Green Goblin and gives up his revenge.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: Hurt that Mary Jane left him for Peter, Harry believes Peter betrayed him and wants nothing more to do with him.
add.whoA: Peter's old friend, who resents him over Mary Jane.
add.whoB: Harry's old friend, whom he blames for taking Mary Jane.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: With Mary Jane and Norman both gone, Harry and Peter make up and become roommates again.
add.whoA: Peter's friend and roommate, Norman Osborn's son.
add.whoB: Harry's friend and roommate.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: Fisk pays for Peter's wedding to thank him for once saving his life, and Peter accepts though he knows Fisk is the Kingpin.
add.whoA: The crime lord behind most of Peter's troubles.
add.whoB: The hero who keeps ruining Fisk's plans.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: The serum that changed Kraven turns Mariah into a feral creature, and Spider-Man helps bring her the cure that partly restores her.
add.whoA: A scientist who helps cure Peter.
add.whoB: Helps Mariah cure Kraven, then her.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)
add.text: Landon has the Shocker seize Morbius so he can study him, until Spider-Man and the Black Cat break in and Morbius drains Landon's plasma.
add.whoA: The Kingpin's mad scientist.
add.whoB: A hero who foils Landon's work.

edit.text: Spider-Carnage escapes into the armored Spider-Man's world, and Spider-Man follows him there. That world's living Uncle Ben reaches the Peter in him, and Spider-Carnage leaps into an unstable portal that destroys him.
